lines.en: I move along the broken wall.

lines.zh: 身体比游荡者更沉，也更稳。
lines.en: Heavier than a roamer, and steadier.

lines.zh: 我走过时，砖缝里的草在动。
lines.en: Grass stirs in the cracks as I pass.
My stride no longer looks human.

lines.zh: 我仰头看天，脖子响了一声。
lines.en: I look up; my neck clicks.
I skirt an overturned cart.
I stop at the empty crossroads.
I turn and walk on.
My steps on gravel sound dull.
I follow blood deeper in.

lines.zh: 我抬手看看自己的指节。
lines.en: I raise my hand and look at the knuckles.

lines.zh: 手指已经不太听使唤了。
lines.en: My fingers don't quite obey.

lines.zh: 我踩过一摊水，水是浑的。
lines.en: I step through a puddle; the water is murky.
I pass under a clothesline.
The cloth brushes my face.
I pause at a door.
I stand at the crossing, still.
Wind blows dust over me.

lines.zh: 我的眼皮迟缓地动了动。
lines.en: My lids move sluggishly.
Something shifts inside me.

lines.zh: 身体里有东西挪动，我不觉得疼。
lines.en: Something shifts inside. I don't feel pain.

lines.zh: 我抬手，摸了摸自己的胸口。
lines.en: I raise a hand to my chest.

lines.zh: 我摸了摸胸口，那里很硬。
lines.en: I touch my chest. It's hard there.
There is a stranger's smell in the air.
There's something alive in the town.

lines.zh: 我一寸一寸把身子转过来。
lines.en: Inch by inch, I turn around.
My clothes are in tatters.
None of it matters to me.

lines.zh: 镇子里还有活气，我慢慢候着。
lines.en: Something still lives in town. I wait.
It'll come out eventually.

lines.zh: 早晚要露头，我不缺耐性。
lines.en: It'll show itself. I have patience.
I'm reflected in the window glass.
I lift my eyes, which turn slowly.

lines.zh: 我抬起头打量，你比我矮。
lines.en: I raise my head. You're shorter than me.
Dragging my feet, I close in.
I come near. She doesn't yield.

lines.zh: 我停在她两步之外，停下。
lines.en: I stop two paces from her.
Stopped, I tilt my head.
I remember this posture.
But not who it belonged to.

lines.zh: 我举起手，又慢慢垂回去。
lines.en: I raise my hand, then let it fall again.
I tilt my head. You hold still.
You've planted yourself. Good.
Good. Neither do I.
Something clicks in my joints.

lines.zh: 皮肉翻开，露出底下的东西。
lines.en: The skin opens and something shows beneath.
The skin opens. I take half a step back.

lines.zh: 伤口早就不流血了，我不吭声。
lines.en: No blood left there. I stay quiet.
No sound from me. I press the wound.
There's no blood there anymore.

lines.zh: 一条腿不太听话，我缓缓抬眼。
lines.en: One leg won't obey. I raise my head slowly.
I raise my head. I can still walk.
My knee locks; I move half a beat late.
I go on, one step at a time.
This thing you set down...
Once I see it, I reach for it.
My fingers won't quite obey.

lines.zh: 手指不听话，我抓了两次。
lines.en: My fingers won't obey. I grab twice.

lines.zh: 两次都滑，第三下才扣住。
lines.en: Two misses, and the third holds.
Got it. I put it in my mouth.
A few chews, and I can't taste it.
I chew anyway.
It catches on the way down.
After swallowing, I want more.
I push the whole thing into my mouth.
My throat hardly works now.

lines.zh: 喉头僵着，我用力往下压。
lines.en: My throat is stiff. I force it down.
After it goes down, my stomach feels heavy.
I haven't felt that in a long time.
I lean on the wall a while.
You bump me and I step back.
Something clacks inside me.

lines.zh: 身体里响了一下，我抬头看你。
lines.en: Something clacks inside. I look up at you.
I look up at you without anger.

lines.zh: 我从你身侧绕开，照样前行。
lines.en: I step around you and walk on.

lines.zh: 路被你堵着，我只好绕开。
lines.en: You block the road, so I go around.

lines.zh: 你堵着道，我停下来候着。
lines.en: You block the road. I stop and wait.

lines.zh: 我停下等了一会，你让开了。
lines.en: I stop and wait. You step aside.
You step aside. I pass.
My shoulder brushes you.

lines.zh: 游荡者之间，早就不这样了。
lines.en: Roamers don't do that anymore.
We have only one thing left.

lines.zh: 我们只剩下一个动作：前进。
lines.en: We have one motion left: forward.
I've assimilated a village.
Now they're all in the line.

lines.zh: 他们全排进队里了，队伍不收脚。
lines.en: They're all in line now. The line doesn't stop.

lines.zh: 队伍走到城外，我回头看了。
lines.en: At the town's edge, I looked back.
They all keep their heads down.
I keep along the road.
There are more villages ahead.

lines.zh: 地上有东西，我弯腰去捡。
lines.en: Something on the ground. I bend for it.
My knee clicks.
I get it anyway.
I turn it over in my hand.
This is still useful.
Still useful. I tuck it inside my coat.
It clinks as I walk.
It clinks as I walk. I don't mind.
I keep it on me.
I keep going. The street is empty.
Across the street, you moved.

lines.zh: 我收住脚，整个人缓缓转向你。
lines.en: I halt, and my whole body turns to you.
My body turns toward you, slowly.

lines.zh: 这姿势我做过无数次，手抬起来。
lines.en: I've made this motion countless times. Up goes my hand.
This motion I know well.
I've done it many times.

lines.zh: 我一步一步朝你挪过去。
lines.en: I shuffle toward you, step by step.
My hand reaches out, half a block short.
My joints creak. I've marked you.
I'm not fast. Here I come.

lines.zh: 这条路我熟，你跑得不慢。
lines.en: I know this road. You run well enough.
But I'm already ahead of you.

lines.zh: 你脚程不差，可这道我走过百回。
lines.en: You're quick, but I've walked this road a hundred times.

lines.zh: 我熟这条路，前面是死巷。
lines.en: I know this road. It's a dead lane ahead.
The alley ends. You stop.

lines.zh: 你收住脚，扭过头来看我。
lines.en: You halt and turn to look at me.

lines.zh: 我没有加快脚步，我走到巷口。
lines.en: I don't quicken my pace. I reach the alley mouth.

lines.zh: 巷子里很暗，你在最里面。
lines.en: It's dark in the alley. You're at the very end.
I don't dodge. I watch you.
Let me come over. Just once.
I reach out to grab.
My fingers rake your arm.
I put a hand out and shove you.
Far stronger than I used to be.

lines.zh: 我一推，你整个人撞在墙上。
lines.en: One shove and you hit the wall.

lines.zh: 我一步步逼近，你把手抬起来。
lines.en: I close in step by step. You raise a hand.
Your hand comes up. I hold it down.
Your resistance weakens.

lines.zh: 你挣得越来越轻，我俯下身。
lines.en: Your struggle fades. I bend lower.
It'll be quick. Don't be afraid.
I step out of the alley.
Most of my hair is gone.
My clothes hang off me.
These hands don't quite look like mine.

lines.zh: 出了巷口，街上空得没有声音。
lines.en: Out of the alley, the street is soundless.

lines.zh: 街上很安静，屋门都关着。
lines.en: The street is quiet. All the doors are shut.

lines.zh: 我从街角转出来，脚步很钝。
lines.en: I turn the corner with heavy steps.
A sound behind a window. I stop.
The window goes still.

lines.zh: 队伍在城外等着，我得回去。
lines.en: The line waits beyond the town. I need to get back.

lines.zh: 火烧起来，我的衣服先着了。
lines.en: Fire catches; my clothes go first.

lines.zh: 落地时我一条腿折在身下。
lines.en: On landing, one leg folds under me.
Water floods in and I can't lift my head.
The blast throws me into the corner.

lines.zh: 肩上多了个洞，我不去管。
lines.en: A hole in my shoulder; I pay it no mind.
The light holds me in place.
My body is eating itself.

lines.zh: 雷劈中我，四肢同时一僵。
lines.en: Lightning strikes; all my limbs lock.
I fall, very quietly.
